name: docs
title: Google Docs API - Developer Preview overlay (hand-written)
description: Hand-written overlay covering the Google Docs API Developer Preview surface launched 2026-07-07 (comment threads, suggestion accept/reject/delete, SUGGEST write mode). The public discovery document does not include this surface, so it is transcribed here from the official reference pages (developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request, .../batchUpdate, .../response, and the documents resource page; all 'Last updated 2026-07-07 UTC', fetched 2026-07-13). This file deliberately mirrors discovery-document format: once the project is enrolled in the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program, replace this file with the real discovery output (fetched with preview visibility) and re-run codegen/generate.py - no generator changes required. Schemas present here but absent from codegen/discovery/docs-v1.json are treated as Developer Preview by the generator.
x_overlayNotes: UNCERTAIN: unanchored-comment behavior of InsertCommentRequest when 'range' is omitted is not explicitly documented (range is currently the only member of the 'anchor' union).
UNCERTAIN: the 'status' enums are inlined on CommentThread (OPEN/RESOLVED) and SuggestionThread (OPEN/ACCEPTED/REJECTED); the real discovery schema names for these enum types are unknown.

UNCERTAIN: whether the Response union gains 'insertComment'/'addCommentReply' members (and their exact member names) is not transcribed; InsertCommentResponse/AddCommentReplyResponse schemas exist per the batchUpdate reference.

UNCERTAIN: whether documents.get exposes CommentThread/SuggestionThread objects in the Document payload (and under which field) could not be confirmed from the reference pages; to be resolved empirically post-enrollment.

Permission rules transcribed from the reference: acceptSuggestion requires edit access (403 otherwise); rejectSuggestion requires edit access OR being the suggestion author; deleteSuggestion requires being the author; deleteComment requires being the author of the headPost; updateCommentPost/deleteCommentReply require being the author of the post.

Request.description: A single update to apply to a document.

insertComment.description: Inserts a comment thread into the document. (Developer Preview)

addCommentReply.description: Inserts a reply post into a comment thread or suggestion thread. (Developer Preview)

updateCommentPost.description: Updates a post in a comment thread or suggestion thread. (Developer Preview)

deleteCommentReply.description: Deletes a reply post from a comment thread or suggestion thread. (Developer Preview)

InsertCommentRequest.description: Inserts a CommentThread into the document. The comment is authored as the authenticated user.

content.description: The text of the comment, as plain text. This field cannot be empty, and must not exceed 2048 UTF-8 code units.

assigneeEmailAddress.description: Optional. The email address of the assignee of the comment. Leave empty for a non-assigned comment. May not exceed 2048 UTF-8 code units.

range.description: The Range in the document that is tied to this comment (member of the 'anchor' union; currently the only member). UNCERTAIN: behavior when omitted (unanchored comment) is not explicitly documented.

AddCommentReplyRequest.description: Inserts a reply Post into a CommentThread or SuggestionThread. Exactly one of commentId or suggestionId must be set (thread_id union).

commentId.description: The ID of the CommentThread to add the reply to (thread_id union member).

suggestionId.description: The ID of the SuggestionThread to add the reply to (thread_id union member).

UpdateCommentPostRequest.description: Updates a Post in a CommentThread or SuggestionThread. Returns a 400 bad request error if the post is the headPost of a SuggestionThread, if the requesting user is not the author of the post, or if there are multiple UpdateCommentPostRequests in the same BatchUpdateDocumentRequest for the same postId. Exactly one of commentId or suggestionId must be set (thread_id union).

postId.description: The ID of the post being updated.

content.description: The new text of the comment, as plain text. This field cannot be empty, and must not exceed 2048 UTF-8 code units.

commentId.description: The ID of the CommentThread which the post belongs to (thread_id union member).

suggestionId.description: The ID of the SuggestionThread which the post belongs to (thread_id union member).

DeleteCommentRequest.description: Deletes a CommentThread. Returns a 400 bad request error if the requesting user is not the author of the headPost.

commentId.description: The ID of the CommentThread that is being deleted.

DeleteCommentReplyRequest.description: Deletes a reply Post from a CommentThread or SuggestionThread. Returns a 400 bad request error if the requesting user is not the author of the post, if the reply post contains an action, or if the reply post contains an assignee. Exactly one of commentId or suggestionId must be set (thread_id union).

postId.description: The ID of the reply Post being deleted.

commentId.description: The ID of the CommentThread which the post belongs to (thread_id union member).

suggestionId.description: The ID of the SuggestionThread which the post belongs to (thread_id union member).

AcceptSuggestionRequest.description: Accepts a suggestion. Returns a 403 forbidden error if the requesting user does not have edit access to the document.

RejectSuggestionRequest.description: Rejects a suggestion. Returns a 403 forbidden error if the requesting user does not have edit access to the document and is not the author of the suggestion.

DeleteSuggestionRequest.description: Deletes a suggestion. Returns a 403 forbidden error if the requesting user is not the author of the suggestion.

Post.description: Represents a single post in a comment or suggestion thread. Writable fields when creating a reply: content, assigneeEmail, commentAction, suggestionAction; all other fields are output only.

postId.description: Output only. The unique ID of the post.

content.description: The content of the post. Required to be non-empty if commentAction is not RESOLVE or REOPEN. May not exceed 2048 UTF-8 code units.

contentHtml.description: Output only. The content of the post as HTML.

author.description: Output only. The user who created the post.

createTime.description: Output only. The time the post was created.

updateTime.description: Output only. The time the post was last updated.

deleted.description: Output only. Whether the post is deleted. If true, content and author fields will be empty.

fromImportedDocument.description: Output only. Whether the post is from an imported document.

fromCopiedDocument.description: Output only. Whether the post is from a copied document.

fromDocumentComparison.description: Output only. Whether the post is from a document comparison.

assigneeEmail.description: The email address of the assignee of the comment.

commentAction.description: The action taken with this reply to a comment thread.
enumDescriptions: Default value. This value is unused.
No action change in this post.
This post resolves the thread.
This post reopens the thread.

suggestionAction.description: The action taken with this reply to a suggestion thread.
enumDescriptions: Default value. This value is unused.
No action change in this post.
This post accepts the suggestion.
This post rejects the suggestion.

PostAuthor.description: Represents a user who authored a comment or suggestion post. All fields output only.

displayName.description: The display name of the user. May be absent if the author is anonymous.

me.description: Whether the user is the authenticated user making the request.

user.description: The resource name of the post author user, usable with the Google People API. Format: users/{user}. Not populated if anonymous or from an imported document.

commentId.description: The unique ID of the comment thread.

anchorId.description: The ID of the CommentAnchor in the document that this thread is tied to. Multiple comment threads may be anchored to the same CommentAnchor.

headPost.description: The first post in the thread.

status.description: Whether the thread is open or resolved. UNCERTAIN: real discovery enum type name unknown; values transcribed from the documents resource reference.
enumDescriptions: Default value. This value is unused.
The comment thread is open.
The comment thread is resolved.

plainTextQuote.description: The quoted text from the document when the comment was created, formatted as plain-text (member of the 'quote' union).

SuggestionThread.description: Represents a single suggestion thread. Suggestion threads are created as a byproduct of saving changes to the document while in suggestion mode, and cannot be created directly.

suggestionId.description: The unique ID of the suggestion.

headPost.description: The first post in the thread.

status.description: Whether the thread is open, accepted, or rejected. UNCERTAIN: real discovery enum type name unknown; values transcribed from the documents resource reference.
enumDescriptions: Default value. This value is unused.
The suggestion thread is open.
The suggestion thread is accepted.
The suggestion thread is rejected.

summaryText.description: Summary of the suggested differences in the document, in plain text. May be empty.

summaryHtml.description: Summary of the suggested differences in the document, in HTML. May be empty.

InsertCommentResponse.description: Response message for inserting a comment.

AddCommentReplyResponse.description: Response message for adding a reply.

SuggestionResponse.description: The suggestions which were affected by a given update.

createdSuggestionIds.description: The IDs of suggestions which were created during the update.

updatedSummarySuggestionIds.description: The IDs of suggestions whose summaries were updated during the update.

deletedSuggestionIds.description: The IDs of suggestions which were deleted during the update.

acceptedSuggestionIds.description: The IDs of suggestions which were accepted during the update.

rejectedSuggestionIds.description: The IDs of suggestions which were rejected during the update.

WriteControl.description: Provides control over how write requests are executed.

writeMode.description: How the request updates should be applied to the document. If unspecified, the request updates are applied as normal edits. (Developer Preview)
enumDescriptions: The write mode is unspecified. Defaults to EDIT behavior.
Apply all updates as normal edits.
Apply all updates as suggestions. (Developer Preview)

BatchUpdateDocumentResponse.description: Response message from a BatchUpdateDocument request.

suggestionResponses.description: The suggestions which were affected by each update. This maps 1:1 with the updates. (Developer Preview)

commentUpdateState.description: Whether comment updates were applied in the batch request. Comment/suggestion thread updates can fail to save even when the text mutations in the same batch commit (partial failure); always check this field after batches containing thread operations. (Developer Preview)
enumDescriptions: The status of comment updates is unspecified.
No comment updates were requested in the batch request.
All requested comment updates were applied in the batch request.
All requested comment updates failed.
